market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed-hike repricing and energy inflation. S&P 500 likely range-bound near current levels. Oil above $95 sustains inflation pressure. Rate-sensitive sectors (housing, REITs) under pressure. AI/tech provides offsetting momentum. Expect volatility around CPI data and Fed communications.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Nvidia, Broadcom, Hugging Face) supports multi-quarter tech leadership. Energy transition constrained by geopolitical supply shocks. Trade protectionism reshapes global supply chains. Consumer bifurcation persists. Fed policy uncertainty from political interference creates tail risk. EM underperformance may extend 1-2 quarters.
